notes: Single source of truth for the plugin <-> trainer protocol. The plugin embeds this file and checks every observation field it writes against it, in order.
v2 (2026-09-26): full kit (sword, anchors, glowstone, pearls, xp, pickaxe, double hand), natural terrain (heightmap, boundary), one decision per tick. v1 models do not run on v2.
Frame: positions/velocities are expressed as (right, up, forward) where forward is the horizontal direction from the agent to its opponent. Movement and pearl directions use the same frame.
Scales: value_in_vector = raw / scale, then clipped to [-clip, clip] (clip defaults to 5).
Damage values are health+absorption the target would lose (see DamageCalculator).

fields.name: totems
fields.desc: totems anywhere in inventory incl. hands

fields.name: offhand_totem
fields.desc: 1 if the offhand holds a totem

fields.name: mainhand_totem
fields.desc: 1 if the main hand holds a totem (double hand)

fields.name: eat_progress
fields.desc: ticks spent eating so far (golden apple takes 32)

fields.name: hurt_cooldown
fields.desc: invulnerableTime; while > 10 only damage above last_hurt lands

fields.name: last_hurt
fields.desc: damage of the last hit (pre-armor), meaningful while hurt_cooldown > 10

fields.name: attack_charge
fields.desc: sword swing charge 0..1 (a hit needs >= actions.sword-min-charge)

fields.name: pearl_cooldown
fields.desc: ticks until an ender pearl can be thrown again

fields.name: mining_progress
fields.desc: 0..1 progress of the block being broken

fields.name: center_right
fields.desc: fight-site centre relative to own feet (natural terrain; 0 in flat arenas)

fields.name: boundary
fields.desc: horizontal distance from the site centre / boundary radius (>= 1 loses)

fields.name: rel_right
fields.desc: opponent position relative to own feet (always ~0 by construction of the frame)

fields.name: vel_right
fields.desc: opponent velocity relative to own velocity

fields.name: looking_at_me
fields.desc: cosine between the opponent's look direction and the direction to me

observation.desc: Candidate crystal spots, same order as the 'crystal' action (index i -> action i+1). Placeable ones first.

fields.name: rel_right
fields.desc: crystal position relative to own feet

fields.name: damage_opponent
fields.desc: fresh-hit damage to the opponent if it exploded

fields.name: has_base
fields.desc: obsidian/bedrock already there (else obsidian is placed first)

fields.name: placeable
fields.desc: can be placed right now (same as the action mask)

observation.desc: Nearest crystals already standing, same order as the 'explode' action (index i -> action i+1).

fields.name: damage_opponent
fields.desc: damage if it exploded now (respects the opponent's hurt cooldown)

fields.name: damage_self
fields.desc: damage to me if it exploded now

observation.desc: Candidate anchor spots around the opponent, same order as the 'anchor' action (index i -> action i+1). Placeable ones first.

fields.name: rel_right
fields.desc: anchor block centre relative to own feet

fields.name: damage_opponent
fields.desc: fresh-hit damage to the opponent if detonated there

fields.name: placeable
fields.desc: can be placed right now (same as the action mask)

observation.desc: Nearest respawn anchors within 6 blocks, same order as 'anchor_use' (1+i charge, 3+i detonate).

fields.name: damage_opponent
fields.desc: damage if detonated now (respects the opponent's hurt cooldown)

fields.name: damage_self
fields.desc: damage to me if detonated now

observation.desc: Ground height around own feet on a 9x9 grid in the agent frame: forward -4..4 (rows), right -4..4 (right varies fastest). Top of the highest solid block at or below feet+4, relative to own feet; -8 if none within 8 below.
Blocks around own body, 3 (right -1..1) x 3 (forward -1..1) x 4 (up -1..2); order: up, forward, right (right varies fastest).

fields.name: solid
fields.desc: 1 if the block has a collision shape

branches.name: move
branches.desc: 0 stop, 1 toward opponent, 2 toward-right, 3 right, 4 away-right, 5 away, 6 away-left, 7 left, 8 toward-left

branches.name: sprint
branches.desc: 0/1, only applied when moving toward the opponent and food > 6

branches.name: attack
branches.desc: 0 none, 1 sword hit on the opponent (reach, sight, charged swing)

branches.name: crystal
branches.desc: 0 none, i+1 = place at candidate i (obsidian first if needed)

branches.name: explode
branches.desc: 0 none, i+1 = attack scene crystal i

branches.name: anchor
branches.desc: 0 none, i+1 = place an anchor at anchor candidate i

branches.name: anchor_use
branches.desc: 0 none, 1-2 = charge scene anchor 0-1 with glowstone, 3-4 = detonate scene anchor 0-1

branches.name: block
branches.desc: 0 none, 1 = glowstone shield toward the worst threat, 2 = topblock the nearest crystal base next to me

branches.name: pearl
branches.desc: 0 none, 1-8 = throw in move direction 1-8 (config pitch), 9 = throw at the feet

branches.name: util
branches.desc: 0 none, 1 totem to offhand, 2 eat golden apple, 3 totem to main hand, 4 throw xp bottle

branches.name: mine
branches.desc: 0 none/keep going, 1 = opponent's cover block (obsidian/glowstone), 2 = block ahead at feet, 3 = block ahead at head height

action.execution_order: totems, explode, sword, anchor use, crystal, anchor place, block, pearl, eat/xp, mining, movement

events.desc: Per agent, accumulated since its previous step. The trainer turns these into rewards (trainer/config.yaml).

fields.dealt: health+absorption the opponent lost to me
fields.self_damage: part of 'taken' caused by my own crystals
fields.outcome: only when done: win | loss | timeout | aborted
fields.self_kill: only when done: true if I died to my own crystal
fields.length: only when done: episode length in ticks

messages.transport: TCP 127.0.0.1, one JSON object per line (UTF-8, '\n' terminated). The trainer is the client.
messages.spec: plugin -> trainer: {"type":"spec","protocol":2,"obs_size":N,"branches":[...],"decision_interval":1,"agents":[{"id":0,"arena":1,"side":"A"},...]}. Sent only once every arena is ready (natural terrain generates its sites first).
messages.act: trainer -> plugin: {"type":"act","actions":[[one int per branch], ...]} in the order of the step's agents
messages.error: plugin -> trainer: {"type":"error","message":"..."} then the connection is closed
